content.intro: Events is lesson 105 in Delegates, Lambdas, Events, and Functional Features. Delegates represent callable behavior. Lambdas make small functions easy to express, while events provide a publisher/subscriber pattern with explicit subscription behavior.
content.why_it_matters: Separating a behavior from the code that invokes it supports callbacks, event-driven systems, and composition. This lesson focuses on events and shows how to verify the behavior instead of relying on assumptions.
